data.name: KhanII M
data.detailed_description:
KHAN 2 – The Return of a Legendary Warlord

Twenty years after the original KHAN defined an era of early MMORPGs, the legendary world rises again—reborn, renewed, and more powerful than ever. KHAN 2 is the true continuation of a beloved classic, bringing the essence of the original back to life while expanding it for a new generation of adventurers.

Step into a vast ancient kingdom shaped by war, faith, and heroic conquest. Become a true “Khan”—a warrior forged in battle, tested by fate, and destined to stand among legends.

Experience the Heart of Classic MMORPG Gameplay

A Massive World of Myth and War

Begin your journey from humble lands and venture through deadly forests, forgotten ruins, sacred temples, and war-torn continents. Discover ancient races, mythical beasts, and dark forces threatening to engulf the realm.

Fight, Rise, and Become a Khan

Grow stronger through battles, master unique skills, and face powerful enemies in solo challenges, guild wars, and massive kingdom-wide conflicts.

An Epic Storyline Continuing the First Game

Set years after the original KHAN, the sequel expands the lore with new characters, factions, and sinister threats that push the world toward chaos.

All-New Storyline

Discover an expanded narrative that follows the events after the first KHAN, introducing new heroes, enemies, and conflicts across the land.

Seasonal Battle Pass

Progress through monthly seasons, unlock exclusive rewards, weapon skins, costumes, buffs, and special items designed to keep every moment meaningful.

Year-Round Events

Limited-time quests, special bosses, seasonal festivals, and bonus drop periods ensure the world is always alive and evolving.

Tower Challenge (Tae Tower)

Climb a multi-floor tower where difficulty increases with each level. Earn greater rewards the higher you ascend—perfect for solo players or group parties.

Enhanced Classic MMORPG Combat

Faithful to the original KHAN yet rebuilt for smoothness and modern playstyle. Master class abilities, gear upgrades, and fast-paced battles.

Modern Gear & Rarity System

Collect equipment of various rarities, build your character’s stats, and customize your power progression to suit your playstyle.

Strong Community & Guild System

Join guilds, participate in massive battles, defeat world bosses, and compete for ranking dominance across the kingdom.

Privacy Policy

This game requires acceptance of a third-party EULA

data.short_description: The legendary MMORPG returns. KHAN 2 M brings back the classic experience with modern systems—story content, seasonal battle pass, events, and a challenging tower climb filled with escalating rewards.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4590
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or GTX 1060 or better/ AMD R9 290 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel i5 6500, AMD Ryzen 3-1200 or above
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB, AMD RX570 or above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
